# Vehndr

> Vehndr is a marketplace to discover and book event vendors — makers, creatives, talent, rentals, food, and more — in one place.

Vehndr helps people planning events find trusted local vendors, browse storefronts, send booking requests, and checkout. Vendors can create a free profile, list offerings, and get booked.

## Main pages

- Homepage: https://www.vehndr.com/
- Browse vendors: https://www.vehndr.com/vendors
- Events: https://www.vehndr.com/events
- Vendor signup: https://www.vehndr.com/register
- Support: https://www.vehndr.com/support
- Privacy: https://www.vehndr.com/privacy
- Terms: https://www.vehndr.com/terms
- Refunds: https://www.vehndr.com/refunds
